senses.gloss: m. pl. (נקף, קף) curlings of the web, anything sticking out of the web (threads, knots &c.).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 75b:3">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דשקיל א׳ וכ׳</he> whoever takes threads out of clothes on the Sabbath, is guilty of an act of finishing; v. <cite ref="Q00528"><he>פַּטִישׁ</he></cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="A02936"><he>אַקָּפוּתָא</he></cite>.
